instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME SETUP: Update tailwind.config.js with the colors defined in 'colors.palette'. Ensure 'darkMode' is set to 'class'.
2. GLOBAL CSS: In index.css, override the root variables to match the 'colors.palette'. Set the default background to #050505 and text to #F5F5F0.
3. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css. Apply 'Playfair Display' to all headings (h1-h6) and 'Manrope' to body.
4. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components. Remove default white backgrounds and replace with 'colors.cards.base' styles. Ensure borders are subtle (white/10).
5. LANDING PAGE: Build a high-impact hero section using the 'hero' image and 'gold_rush' gradient for the CTA. Use the 'backgrounds' image as a subtle texture for feature sections.
6. DASHBOARD: Use the 'Bento' grid layout. Create a 'Transfer' card that is prominent. Use the 'brand_partners' colors for the provider selection buttons (e.g., a Yellow button for Western Union).
7. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all text on the Gold primary color is BLACK, not white, for contrast. Use 'data-testid' on all interactive elements.
8. NO TRANSPARENCY: Never use fully transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or headers. Use 'bg-black/90' or similar with blur.
9. FILE EXTENSIONS: You are working with .js and .jsx files. Do not use .ts/.tsx.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for dark colors.
Avoid generic centered layouts; use asymmetry.
Add micro-interactions to every button and card.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
